name: Consumer
intro: Superworld’s magnetic and EMC components support efficient power conversion, noise suppression and wireless connectivity in compact audio devices and connected appliances.

summary.heading: From everyday devices to smarter consumer experiences.
summary.text: Explore component solutions for consumer electronics, from portable audio and connected devices to intelligent home appliances.

designTitle: SUPPORT COMPACT AND EFFICIENT CONSUMER ELECTRONICS
designIntro: Enable compact designs, efficient power delivery and reliable connectivity.

quality.manufacturing: Controlled production supports consistent component supply for compact audio devices and connected appliances.
quality.performance: Magnetic and EMC component options help deliver steady power and filter noise in audio, radio and control circuits.
quality.engineering: Superworld can help match component size, power needs and filtering goals to your device.

journey.identify: Choose the consumer system you are designing, from portable audio to a robotic cleaner or air purifier.
journey.review: Open the relevant circuit area and identify its power, RF or noise-control needs.
journey.match: Compare compact magnetic and EMC options using the series information and datasheets.
journey.contact: Send your circuit area, available board space and preferred series to our sales team.

support: Share your device type, circuit area and available board space so Superworld can help you select components.

needs.title: Reduce EMI & Noise
needs.text: Support noise suppression across power, audio and signal circuits.

needs.title: Enable Compact Designs
needs.text: Provide compact and low-profile magnetic component options for space-constrained products.

systems.title: Speakers
systems.summary: Audio products combine wireless connectivity, power conversion and sensitive signal paths in compact enclosures.

modules.title: WiFi / Bluetooth
modules.description: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connect the speaker to audio sources and controls.
modules.need: Support clean radio power and RF matching in compact audio products.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on the low-voltage radio supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Support RF matching in a compatible antenna network.
mappings.condition: Circuit topology, target frequency, Q, parasitics and antenna co-design must be specified.

modules.title: DC-DC Converter
modules.description: Local conversion supplies the amplifier, radio and control electronics.
modules.need: Support efficient power delivery within the available board space.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage switching regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

modules.title: Power Conditioning
modules.description: Power conditioning helps keep supply noise away from audio and control circuits.
modules.need: Filter input and supply noise while maintaining power delivery.

mappings.why: Filter noise on a low-voltage branch after the input regulator.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Reduce common-mode noise in a compatible filter position.
mappings.condition: Check current, impedance curve, differential signal integrity and layout.

mappings.why: Receive power in a compatible inductive charging circuit.
mappings.condition: Verify protocol/controller pairing, coil alignment, operating frequency, power and enclosure spacing.

modules.title: Speaker, Headphone and Microphone
modules.description: Speaker, headphone and microphone circuits handle audio output and sensitive input signals.
modules.need: Support low-noise audio supplies without excessive voltage drop.

mappings.why: Filter noise on microphone bias or an audio-control supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Store energy in a separate low-voltage regulator for the audio electronics.
mappings.condition: Select for the regulator topology, inductance, peak current and available height.

modules.consultation: Share the audio supply topology, signal levels and filtering requirements for review.

systems.title: Hearable Products
systems.summary: Wearables prioritize low profile, limited battery capacity, reliable connectivity and careful thermal design.

modules.title: Connectivity
modules.description: The radio carries audio and control signals in a compact wearable.
modules.need: Support a stable wireless link within a small layout.

mappings.why: Support RF matching when the radio has an external antenna network.
mappings.condition: Circuit topology, target frequency, Q, parasitics and antenna co-design must be specified.

modules.title: DC-DC Converter
modules.description: Local conversion supplies the battery-powered audio and radio circuits.
modules.need: Support compact conversion for low-power wearable electronics.

mappings.why: Support an auxiliary rail within the selected L2 part’s current rating.
mappings.condition: The documented L2 variants are rated 15–50 mA. Confirm the selected part’s rating, rail load and regulator topology.

modules.title: Battery
modules.description: The battery power path supplies the wearable and manages charging.
modules.need: Support charging in the space available in the wearable or its case.
modules.consultation: Share the battery and charging-case dimensions, charging method and controller requirements to evaluate a contact or wireless charging architecture.

componentGuidance.purpose: Receive power in a compatible contactless charging case with room for the selected receiver.

systems.title: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
systems.summary: UAV subsystems need compact power magnetics and noise control around radio, camera and control electronics.

modules.title: Remote Control
modules.description: The handheld controller sends flight commands and receives telemetry.
modules.need: Support clean control power and a stable radio link.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on the handset’s radio or control supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Support RF matching in a compatible remote-control antenna network.
mappings.condition: Circuit topology, target frequency, Q, parasitics and antenna co-design must be specified.

modules.title: Charger
modules.description: The charger manages power delivery to the battery pack.
modules.need: Support compact conversion for the selected charging architecture.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage charger regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

mappings.why: Receive power in a compatible inductive charging design.
mappings.condition: Verify protocol, power, alignment, charger IC, thermal path and enclosure clearance.

modules.title: Camera
modules.description: The camera captures images and processes video for the system.
modules.need: Support low-noise power for the image sensor and processor.

mappings.why: Filter noise on a low-voltage sensor or image-processor supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage camera regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

modules.title: Vehicle Control Module
modules.description: The flight controller processes sensor inputs and sends commands to the vehicle electronics.
modules.need: Support stable power for flight-control logic and sensors.

mappings.why: Filter noise on a low-voltage logic or sensor supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage control regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

systems.title: Robotic Cleaner
systems.summary: Robotic cleaners integrate digital control, wireless links, sensors, conversion stages and a display panel.

modules.title: CPU
modules.description: The processor coordinates navigation, sensing and cleaning functions.
modules.need: Keep supply noise away from the control processor.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on a documented processor supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

modules.title: Wireless Connectivity
modules.description: Wireless connectivity supports app control and status updates.
modules.need: Support a stable connection alongside switching and motor noise.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on the low-voltage radio supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Support RF matching in a compatible antenna network.
mappings.condition: Circuit topology, target frequency, Q, parasitics and antenna co-design must be specified.

modules.title: Sensor
modules.description: Sensors support navigation, obstacle detection and device monitoring.
modules.need: Support low-noise power delivery around sensitive sensing circuits.

mappings.why: Filter noise on a documented sensor supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage sensor regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

modules.title: AC-DC Converter
modules.description: The AC-DC stage supplies downstream circuits from AC input.
modules.need: Support low-noise output power within the chosen supply topology.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on a separately identified low-voltage output branch.
mappings.condition: Choose the bead for measured noise, DC-bias impedance, rail current and allowable voltage drop.

modules.consultation: Mains topology, isolation, safety standards, surge/inrush, transformer windings and working-voltage evidence require product-engineering review.

modules.title: DC-DC Converter
modules.description: The DC-DC stage supplies regulated power to control and sensor circuits.
modules.need: Support efficient conversion across changing device loads.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage switching regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

modules.title: Display Panel
modules.description: The display presents device status and user controls.
modules.need: Support clean display power and stable communication with the controller.

mappings.why: Filter noise on the low-voltage display logic supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

mappings.why: Reduce common-mode noise on a compatible display interface.
mappings.condition: Verify signal protocol, line impedance, current, insertion loss and layout.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage display regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

modules.consultation: Share the interface and display supply to review suitable filtering or power components.

systems.title: Air Purifier
systems.summary: Air-purifier control and power boards benefit from validated EMI filtering and appropriately rated power magnetics.

modules.title: CPU
modules.description: The processor coordinates fan settings, sensing and system status.
modules.need: Support a stable processor supply near switching loads.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on the processor supply.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

modules.title: Driver Board
modules.description: The driver board controls the fan motor.
modules.need: Reduce switching noise on the driver’s low-voltage control supply.

mappings.why: Filter noise on the low-voltage driver control rail.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

modules.title: DC-DC Converter
modules.description: Local converters supply regulated power to sensing and control circuits.
modules.need: Support efficient conversion in the available board area.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage switching regulator.
mappings.condition: Choose by topology, inductance, saturation/rated current, DCR, switching frequency, thermal rise, and footprint.

modules.title: Power Supply
modules.description: The power supply delivers power to the control and driver boards.
modules.need: Support clean power on the downstream low-voltage rails.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on a separately identified low-voltage output branch.
mappings.condition: Confirm noise spectrum, DC current/bias, impedance curve, DCR, temperature rise and footprint; validate rail transient response.

modules.consultation: Share the power topology and working-voltage, isolation and surge requirements for a supply review.
